front: How do you handle a passage contradicting what you learned?
why: Passage-over-outside-knowledge rule decides answers on nearly every exam

front: How should you read passages with multiple experiments?
why: Tracking what changed between experiments is where multi-experiment questions hinge

front: How should you treat the introductory paragraph of a science passage?
why: Intro-paragraph framing; helpful orientation, secondary tactic

front: What is the difference between reading for gist and reading for detail?
why: Gist vs detail restates the skim-first approach

front: What is the role of the final paragraph in science passages?
why: Final-paragraph conclusions/limitations; useful for inference questions

front: What should you do with a dense methods description?
why: Extracting manipulated/measured from dense methods is a tactic on most passages

front: What signals that a sentence is likely to be tested?
why: Flagging comparisons, causal claims and surprises targets what gets asked

front: Why is annotating sparingly better than heavily?
why: Annotation-economy advice; time tactic of secondary value
